metadata.title: भूंजिया आदिवासियों का पवित्र लाल बंगले का रहस्य | Sacred Life of the Chuktia Bhunjia Tribe of Odisha
metadata.description:
Hidden deep within the dense forests of the Sunabeda plateau in Nuapada district, Odisha, lives one of India’s most unique and least-known tribal communities — the Chuktia Bhunjia.
This Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) continues to preserve its distinct identity, culture, and sacred traditions, far from the influence of the modern world.

In this episode, Main Bhi Bharat takes you inside the mystical forests of Sunabeda to explore the life, customs, and beliefs of the Chuktia Bhunjia people — their sacred kitchen called Lalbangala, the worship of goddess Sunadei, and the powerful connection they share with nature.

We also trace how government programmes like the Chuktia Bhunjia Development Agency (CBDA) are trying to bring development to the region, without breaking the cultural ethos of this ancient community.

 Watch this exclusive ground report to understand how the Chuktia Bhunjia are balancing tradition and change in the heart of Odisha’s forests.
